en.commentary:
I rank a nootropic on one question: can I read the label and find a clinically studied ingredient at a clinically studied dose? Mind Lab Pro v4 answers that eleven times on a single panel, which is why it takes first place at $69 for a thirty-day supply. Cognizin citicoline at 250 mg, bacopa standardized to 24 percent bacosides, lion's mane fruiting body and Suntheanine L-theanine all appear in plain milligrams, and the whole formula runs caffeine free so I keep control of my own stimulant load with my morning coffee.

Performance Lab Mind lands second because it does the same job with four ingredients at $59, which makes it the cleanest base layer for anyone already taking creatine, omega-3 or their own caffeine.

Third place goes to Jarrow Citicoline at $33.99 for 120 capsules. Citicoline carries the deepest human trial record of any single compound in this category, and at roughly 28 cents a day this is where I send anyone who wants the evidence on its own. Qualia Mind delivers the widest ingredient panel here and I feel it on heavy writing days, with $139 a bottle placing it in a different budget conversation. Thorne Memoractiv earns its position on manufacturing standards, since Thorne runs four third-party certifications and supplies NSF Certified for Sport lines to professional teams.

The 2026 market backs this framing. Nootropics now sit in a category worth roughly $6 to $7 billion and growing at a double-digit annual rate, and more than 61 percent of buyers say they want plant-based, naturally sourced formulas. That demand is exactly what pushed transparent, fully dosed labels to the front of the shelf.

My practical advice: pick one product, run it for eight weeks, and hold the rest of your routine steady. Bacopa and lion's mane need that long to show anything measurable. Citicoline and L-theanine work inside an hour, so start there if you want a same-day read on whether this category does anything for you.

highlights.title: Mind Lab Pro v4 is the bottle I would buy first, and the label is the reason
highlights.body: Eleven nootropics, every one printed with its own milligram figure, is the rarest thing in this category. Cognizin citicoline at 250 mg matches the dose used in published attention work, the bacopa is standardized to 24 percent bacosides rather than sold as raw herb weight, and the lion's mane is fruiting body. At $69 for thirty servings it costs $2.30 a day, and the caffeine-free build means I can drink my usual coffee and still know exactly how much stimulant I took.

highlights.title: Citicoline alone at 28 cents a day is the smartest entry point in this whole category
highlights.body: Jarrow sells 120 capsules of 250 mg citicoline for $33.99, and citicoline is the compound in this space with the deepest human trial record behind attention and processing speed. Anyone new to nootropics should run this single ingredient for a month before spending $139 on a twenty-compound stack. It gives you a clean read on whether your brain responds to choline support, and that answer tells you which of the bigger formulas is worth your money.

highlights.title: Caffeine-free formulas win because they let you control the stimulant separately
highlights.body: Mind Lab Pro, Performance Lab Mind, NooCube and Thorne Memoractiv all leave caffeine out, and I score that as a design advantage. Your caffeine tolerance shifts week to week and your coffee habit already sets a baseline. Keeping the stimulant in your cup and the cognitive support in your capsule means you can adjust one without disturbing the other, and it keeps an afternoon dose available when you need focus late in the day.

highlights.title: Eight weeks is the honest trial period for anything herbal
highlights.body: Bacopa monnieri trials that show memory improvement run twelve weeks, and lion's mane work runs eight to sixteen. If you judge a bacopa-based formula after five days you are measuring your sleep quality, not the supplement. Buy a two-month supply, keep your sleep and training steady while you take it, and write down one concrete measure such as how far into an afternoon you can hold deep work. That is the only way to get a signal out of the noise.

highlights.title: Published certificates of analysis separate the top of this list from the rest
highlights.body: Thorne carries four third-party certifications and manufactures NSF Certified for Sport lines for professional teams. Nootropics Depot publishes certificates of analysis by lot number, so you can look up the exact bottle in your hand. In a supplement category where potency claims are easy to print and hard to check, that level of documentation is worth paying for, and it is a large part of why both brands rank where they do.

zh-tw.commentary:
老實說，益智補給這種東西我只看一件事：標示上有沒有寫清楚成分和劑量，而且那個劑量背後有沒有人體研究撐著。

Mind Lab Pro v4 排第一，就是因為它把這件事做了十一次。Cognizin citicoline 250 毫克、標準化到 24% bacosides 的假馬齒莧、猴頭菇子實體、Suntheanine 茶胺酸，全部用毫克老老實實印在瓶身上。而且整罐不含咖啡因，我可以照常喝我的早餐店冰美式，咖啡因要抓多少自己說了算。一個月份 69 美金，換算一天七十幾塊台幣，跟你每天那杯手搖差不多的價位。

Performance Lab Mind 排第二，四個成分、59 美金，如果你本來就在吃肌酸、魚油，或是自己補咖啡因，這罐是最乾淨的底層。

第三名 Jarrow Citicoline 我認為是整份榜單裡最划算的一罐。120 顆 33.99 美金，一天不到十塊台幣，而 citicoline 是這個品類裡人體試驗資料最厚的單一成分。想先確認自己對這類東西有沒有反應的人，我一律建議從這罐開始。

Qualia Mind 的成分表最豐富，趕稿那幾天我確實感覺得出來，只是一瓶 139 美金，那已經是另一個預算層級的討論了。Thorne Memoractiv 則是贏在製造標準，Thorne 手上四張第三方認證，NSF Certified for Sport 那條產線是直接供職業運動隊的。

市場面也支持這個判斷。益智補給 2026 年的規模大概落在 60 到 70 億美金，年成長率維持在兩位數，而且超過 61% 的消費者明講他們要植物來源的天然配方。這股需求就是把「劑量標示清楚」的產品推到貨架最前面的原因。

給你一個很實際的建議：一次只吃一罐，連續吃滿八週，其他作息盡量維持不變。假馬齒莧和猴頭菇本來就要八週才看得出東西。citicoline 和茶胺酸一小時內就有感，想當天就知道有沒有用，從這兩個下手最快。

highlights.title: Mind Lab Pro v4 是我會第一個買的那罐，關鍵就在那張標示
highlights.body: 十一種益智成分，每一種都標出自己的毫克數，這在益智補給裡真的很少見。Cognizin citicoline 250 毫克剛好對上已發表的專注力研究劑量，假馬齒莧標的是 24% bacosides 而不是原料重量，猴頭菇用的是子實體。69 美金三十份，一天大概七十幾塊台幣，加上整罐不含咖啡因，我早上那杯冰美式照喝，咖啡因總量心裡有數。

highlights.title: 一天不到十塊的單方 citicoline，是整個品類最聰明的入門
highlights.body: Jarrow 120 顆 250 毫克 citicoline 賣 33.99 美金，而 citicoline 是這個領域裡專注力和處理速度人體資料最厚的成分。第一次接觸益智補給的人，我建議先吃這個單方一個月，再考慮要不要花 139 美金買二十幾種成分的複方。這一個月會很乾脆地告訴你，你的腦袋對膽鹼支援到底有沒有反應，而這個答案就決定了後面哪罐複方值得你掏錢。

highlights.title: 不含咖啡因的配方會贏，因為提神這件事該由你自己控制
highlights.body: Mind Lab Pro、Performance Lab Mind、NooCube 和 Thorne Memoractiv 都把咖啡因拿掉了，我把這當成設計上的優勢。你的咖啡因耐受度每週都在變，而且你本來就有喝咖啡的習慣打底。把提神留在杯子裡、把認知支援留在膠囊裡，你就能單獨調整其中一邊而不影響另一邊。更重要的是，下午三四點想再加一份的時候你不用擔心晚上睡不著。

highlights.title: 植物性成分的誠實試用期是八週，這點沒得商量
highlights.body: 假馬齒莧那些看得到記憶力改善的試驗，週期都拉到十二週，猴頭菇則落在八到十六週。你吃五天就下結論，那量到的是你的睡眠品質，跟這罐補給沒什麼關係。建議直接買兩個月的量，這段期間睡眠和運動盡量維持原樣，然後記錄一個具體指標，例如你下午能專心撐到幾點。這是唯一能從雜訊裡撈出訊號的方法。

highlights.title: 願意公開檢驗報告的品牌，就是這份榜單前段班的分水嶺
highlights.body: Thorne 手上四張第三方認證，還幫職業運動隊生產 NSF Certified for Sport 產線的產品。Nootropics Depot 則是每個批號的檢驗報告都掛在官網上，你手上那罐的批號查得到。保健品這種東西，含量數字印起來容易、驗起來難，這種等級的文件是真的值得多付一點錢，這也是這兩個牌子能排在這個位置的一大原因。

en.commentary:
Mind Lab Pro v4 holds first on transparency, which is the only thing that lets you evaluate a nootropic before you take it. Every ingredient is listed at its exact dose with no proprietary blend hiding the amounts, and the doses match what the underlying studies used. A blend that lists eleven ingredients and one total milligram figure is telling you nothing, and most of this category does exactly that.

Citicoline at third deserves specific attention. Jarrow's CDP-Choline 250 is a single ingredient at a studied dose, and citicoline has among the better evidence bases here for attention and processing speed. If you want to know whether a nootropic works for you, start with one compound rather than a stack of eleven, because a stack that works gives you no information about which part did the work.

Lion's mane at sixth is worth noting given a September 2025 systematic review supporting it for cognitive function and for anxiety and depression markers. That is stronger evidence than most ingredients in this category carry.

Prevagen sits last, and I want to state plainly why. Its active ingredient is a protein that digestion breaks down before absorption, and its marketing claims have drawn regulatory and legal challenge. There are better places to put your money, and nine of them are listed above it.

highlights.title: Proprietary blends exist so you cannot evaluate the dose
highlights.body: A label listing eleven ingredients under one total milligram figure tells you nothing about whether any of them is present at a studied amount. Mind Lab Pro v4 lists every ingredient at its exact dose, matched to the studies behind it. If a brand will not disclose per-ingredient amounts, treat that as a decision they made about what you should be able to verify.

highlights.title: Start with one compound if you want to learn anything
highlights.body: Jarrow's Citicoline CDP-Choline 250 is a single ingredient at a studied dose, and citicoline carries among the better evidence bases here for attention and processing speed. An eleven-ingredient stack that works tells you nothing about which component did it, and stacks that do nothing leave you with no next step. Single ingredients produce information you can act on.

highlights.title: Lion's mane has the strongest recent evidence in this category
highlights.body: A September 2025 systematic review supported lion's mane for cognitive function alongside anxiety and depression markers, which is a stronger evidence base than most ingredients here carry. Nootropics Depot's 8:1 dual extract specifies both the extraction ratio and the method, which matters because water-only extracts miss the compounds a dual extraction captures.

highlights.title: Prevagen ranks last for a specific reason
highlights.body: Its active ingredient is a protein, and digestion breaks proteins down into amino acids before absorption, so the mechanism its marketing describes is difficult to reconcile with how digestion works. Its advertising claims have also faced regulatory and legal challenge. Nine products above it in this ranking give you better-evidenced ingredients at comparable or lower prices.

zh-tw.commentary:
Mind Lab Pro v4 靠透明度坐穩第一，而透明度是唯一能讓你在吃下去之前就評估一款益智補充品的東西。每個成分都標示確切劑量，沒有用專有配方把數字藏起來，而且劑量對得上背後研究使用的量。一張列了十一種成分卻只給一個總毫克數的標示，等於什麼都沒告訴你，而這個品類多數產品就是這樣做的。

第三名的胞磷膽鹼值得單獨提。Jarrow 的 CDP-Choline 250 是單一成分、研究劑量，而胞磷膽鹼在注意力跟處理速度上的證據基礎，在這裡算是比較好的那一群。想知道某個益智成分對你有沒有用，就從單一化合物開始，不要從十一種的組合開始，因為一個有效的組合，完全沒告訴你是哪一部分在起作用。

第六名的獅鬃菇值得注意，2025 年九月一份系統性回顧支持它在認知功能以及焦慮與憂鬱指標上的作用。那比這個品類多數成分擁有的證據都強。

Prevagen 排最後，我想把原因講白。它的活性成分是一種蛋白質，而消化作用會在吸收前把蛋白質分解掉，它的行銷宣稱也面臨過主管機關與法律上的挑戰。你的錢有更好的去處，而且上面就列了九個。

highlights.title: 專有配方存在的目的，就是讓你無法評估劑量
highlights.body: 一張列了十一種成分卻只給一個總毫克數的標示，完全沒告訴你其中任何一項有沒有達到研究劑量。Mind Lab Pro v4 每個成分都標示確切劑量，並且對得上背後的研究。如果一個品牌不肯揭露個別成分的含量，那就把它當成他們對「你應該能驗證什麼」所做的決定。

highlights.title: 想學到東西，就從單一成分開始
highlights.body: Jarrow 的 Citicoline CDP-Choline 250 是單一成分、研究劑量，而胞磷膽鹼在注意力跟處理速度上的證據基礎在這裡算好的。一個十一種成分的複方有效了，你完全不知道是哪一項在做事；沒效的話，你也沒有下一步可走。單一成分產生的是你可以據以行動的資訊。

highlights.title: 這個品類近期證據最強的是獅鬃菇
highlights.body: 2025 年九月的系統性回顧支持獅鬃菇在認知功能以及焦慮與憂鬱指標上的作用，證據基礎比這裡多數成分都強。Nootropics Depot 的 8:1 雙重萃取有標明萃取比例跟方法，這件事重要，因為單純水萃會漏掉雙重萃取才抓得到的那些化合物。

highlights.title: Prevagen 排最後有明確的理由
highlights.body: 它的活性成分是一種蛋白質，而消化作用會在吸收前把蛋白質分解成胺基酸，所以它行銷描述的機制，很難跟消化的實際運作對得上。它的廣告宣稱也面臨過主管機關與法律上的挑戰。這份榜單上面那九個產品，用相同或更低的價格給你證據更充分的成分。
